role: Output side of the live-workout coach: owned by WorkoutRecorder, it is fed a WorkoutAIContext each recorder tick, runs the rule-based WorkoutTriggerEngine plus the mile-marker, turn-alert and turn-marker engines, and speaks their lines via the shared VoiceConversationController (preferred) or its own AVSpeechSynthesizer. Also holds the in-session mute and exposes the app-language voice helper used by other TTS paths.
types: WorkoutVoiceCoach: class (@Observable @MainActor final) — workout TTS coach, engine state holder, mute toggle
state: mem:WorkoutVoiceCoach.watchBridge (private weak WatchConnectivityBridge; stored, never read)
toplevel: Stored-property initializers: isMuted=false, hasAnnouncedSubsystem=false, fresh MileMarkerState/TurnAlertState/TurnMarkerState, routeEngagedAt=nil; synthesizer and cueReleaser are lazy (built on first speak, cueReleaser resolves AppDependencies.current.collection.backgroundAudioManager at that time). static ambientFixMaxAgeSec=10.
